name: Plannotator Inbox
author: Aidan Timson
description: Threads waiting on you in the local Plannotator Inbox, opened as an Omarchy web app

barWidget.description: Counts the Inbox threads that wait on you and lists them in a panel. Left click opens the panel, right click opens the Inbox web app, middle click refreshes.

schema.label: Primary output
schema.description: Optional output name used when primary output only is enabled.

schema.label: Web app address
schema.description: Address the web app opens. Empty uses the Inbox's own loopback URL from ~/.plannotator/inbox/inbox.json; set it to an HTTPS front when one sits in front of the Inbox.

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the thread list is re-read when the live event stream is off or dropped.

schema.label: Live updates
schema.description: Follow the Inbox's event stream so the count changes as soon as an agent writes.

schema.label: Show when nothing waits
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar while no thread waits on you.
